description: Set grouping on a view. Default mode replaces all existing group levels — pass an empty array with operation="replace" to clear grouping. Use operation="append" to add new group levels below the existing ones without rewriting them.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

groupLevels.description: Array of group levels. Empty array [] clears grouping when operation="replace".

emptyGroupState.description: "hidden" only — the Airtable API rejects "visible" with INVALID_REQUEST. Omit this field or pass "hidden". Default: "hidden".

operation.description: How the given groupLevels interact with existing ones. "replace" (default) overwrites; "append" adds the provided levels after the existing group stack.

name: update_view_group_levels
